android.desc:
ACRO: is a social word game where you challenge your friends to be the most creative author of a one-liner.

Each day a new set of letters is ready and players create a sentence with those initials: can be funny, deep, or one-of-a-kind. 
All creations will be shared with your personal friend's league, and globally on the world league.

Acro is currently playable in English, Italian, Spanish, French with each country having its own League, with more to come.
